name: 1st-Degree Droids
summary: Medical and Analytical 1st-Degree Droids have the following traits:

fields.ability_modifiers: All 1st-Degree Droids receive +2 bonuses to both their Intelligence and Wisdom, but suffer a -2 penalty to their Strength.
fields.behavioral_inhibitors: 1st-Degree Droids firstly cannot knowingly harm a sentient creature, unless another creature would be harmed due to inaction. 1st-Degree Droids secondly obey orders from their designated owner (whether that be an actual owner or themselves).
fields.droid_talents: All 1st-Degree Droids can select Droid Talents from the 1st-Degree Droid Talent Tree.
